stories.title: Broncos say trade with Chargers for LB Henley 'will not be finalized'
stories.summary: The Broncos announced late Wednesday that their trade to acquire linebacker Daiyan Henley from the Chargers "will not be finalized."

stories.title: Manchester United fires Carrick; sources say deal with USMNT's Pochettino close
stories.summary: Manchester United have sacked head coach Michael Carrick, the club have confirmed.

stories.title: Curry injures abdomen, heads for MRI with Warriors' concern level 'high'
stories.summary: Stephen Curry injured his right abdomen in the first quarter, with Steve Kerr saying after the game that the "concern is high" as they await test results.

stories.title: Zion calls out Pels after latest blowout loss: 'Have to look yourself in mirror'
stories.summary: Zion Williamson called for accountability after the Pelicans lost their fourth straight game, saying the team needed to look itself in the mirror.

stories.title: Sources: Rivers-to-NC State deal set to be finalized after Friday board meeting
stories.summary: Philip Rivers is set to return to NC State, this time as head football coach, once its trustees finalizes his contract after a meeting Friday, sources said.
